current.provenance: fresh Playwright browser render; 1672x941 CSS px, DPR 1; no resize or crop before ROI extraction

geometryMethod.source: Vite SSR loaded buildInteriors, DEPARTMENTS, HOME camera from current source; box corners/cylinder circumference sampled at 32 points and spheres at 26 directions are projected through the unchanged HOME camera.
geometryMethod.note: Where a catalogue px_box exists, projected model composite bounds are compared against it. For items without a measured reference box, current projected bounds are diagnostics only and are not presented as ground-truth geometry errors.

metricsMethod.mae: Mean absolute RGB channel error, 0–255, computed over the entire full rectangular department ROI.
metricsMethod.ssim: Mean grayscale SSIM over 8x8 uniform windows, stride 4, C1=(0.01*255)^2 and C2=(0.03*255)^2; a disclosed box-window variant, not masked.
metricsMethod.localizedImpact: L1 error sum within object-specific screen box; item boxes are the catalogued ref px_box where present, otherwise the projected current composite box for diagnostics. Boxes can overlap, so summed attribution is not additive; sort is within a department.
